name: duda
description: Build and manage Duda projects from Claude. Duda Editor sites: pages, navigation, popups, theme, collections, content library, blog, ecommerce, bookings, marketing, and URL rules. Vibe projects (websites and apps): build and change them with Duda's AI agent, view form submissions, and publish. AI Visibility: see how often AI assistants mention a site or any domain against its competitors, run one-time reports, and track it over time. Client accounts and site access work for both.
